text.p: Foods group Inno-Pacific Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had revised the terms to its proposed right issue.
The company said in a statement it was now proposing a renounceable rights issue of 236.82 million rights shares on the basis of one rights share for every ordinary share held.
In June, Inno-Pacific proposed a renounceable rights issue on the basis of three rights shares for every one ordinary share held.
The company said on Monday its issue of 59.20 million detachable warrants remained unchanged, on the basis of one warrant for every four shares held.
The rights issue will be managed by N M Rothschild & Sons (S) Ltd and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Merchant Bank (S) Ltd.
Inno-Pacific said the net proceeds from the rights issue of about Singapore $49.8 million would finance the purchase of commercial and industrial buildings and provide working capital.
In its June proposal, the company said it expected a net proceeds of S$211.44 million from the rights issue.
